senses.gloss: चुकोपयिषु चुकोपयिषु, i. e. चुकोपयिष, desiderative of the Causal of कुप्, + उ, adj. Desiring to make wrathful, MBh. 8, 1793.

† चुक्क् चुक्क्, i. 10, Par. To give pain.
 --Cf. चक्क्.
चुक्र चुक्र, m. A kind of vinegar, made of fruits, Suśr. 2, 365, 17.
चुक्षोभयिषु चुक्षोभयिषु, i. e. चुक्षोभयिष, desider. of the Causal of क्षुभ्, + उ, adj. Desiring to cause to waver, Man. 7, 1142.
